title: Altering the Double-Stranded DNA Specificity of the bZIP Domain of Zta with Site-Directed Mutagenesis at N182.
authors: Ray, Sreejana; Tillo, Desiree; Assad, Nima; Ufot, Aniekanabasi; Porollo, Aleksey; Durell, Stewart R; Vinson, Charles
one_liner_zh: 该文通过定点突变和分子动力学模拟研究bZIP转录因子Zta的N182残基对双链DNA结合特异性的影响，聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法包含MD模拟，高度匹配课题。
abstract: Zta, the Epstein-Barr virus bZIP transcription factor (TF), binds both unmethylated and methylated double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) in a sequence-specific manner. We studied the contribution of a conserved asparagine (N182) to sequence-specific dsDNA binding to four types of dsDNA: (i) dsDNA with cytosine in both strands ((DNA(C|C)), (ii, iii) dsDNA with 5-methylcytosine (5mC, M) or 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC, H) in one strand and cytosine in the second strand ((DNA(5mC|C) and DNA(5hmC|C)), and (iv) dsDNA with methylated cytosine in both strands in all CG dinucleotides ((DNA(5mCG)). We replaced asparagine with five similarly sized amino acids (glutamine (Q), serine (S), threonine (T), isoleucine (I), or valine (V)) and used protein binding microarrays to evaluate sequence-specific dsDNA binding. Zta preferentially binds the pseudo-palindrome TRE (AP1) motif (T(-4)G(-3)A(-2G)/(C) (0)T(2)C(3)A(4) ). Zta (N182Q) changes binding to A(3) in only one half-site. Zta(N182S) changes binding to G(3) in one or both halves of the motif. Zta(N182S) and Zta(N182Q) have 34- and 17-fold weaker median dsDNA binding, respectively. Zta(N182V) and Zta(N182I) have increased binding to dsDNA(5mC|C). Molecular dynamics simulations rationalize some of these results, identifying hydrogen bonds between glutamine and A(3) , but do not reveal why serine preferentially binds G(3) , suggesting that entropic interactions may mediate this new binding specificity.
abstract_zh: Zta，即爱泼斯坦-巴尔病毒bZIP转录因子（TF），以序列特异性方式结合未甲基化和甲基化的双链DNA（dsDNA）。我们研究了保守的天冬酰胺（N182）对四种类型dsDNA序列特异性结合的作用：(i) 两条链均含胞嘧啶的dsDNA（(DNA(C|C)），(ii, iii) 一条链含5-甲基胞嘧啶（5mC, M）或5-羟甲基胞嘧啶（5hmC, H）而另一条链含胞嘧啶的dsDNA（(DNA(5mC|C)和DNA(5hmC|C)），以及(iv) 所有CG二核苷酸中两条链均含甲基化胞嘧啶的dsDNA（(DNA(5mCG)）。我们将天冬酰胺替换为五种大小相似的氨基酸（谷氨酰胺（Q）、丝氨酸（S）、苏氨酸（T）、异亮氨酸（I）或缬氨酸（V）），并使用蛋白质结合微阵列评估序列特异性dsDNA结合。Zta优先结合伪回文TRE（AP1）基序（T(-4)G(-3)A(-2G)/(C) (0)T(2)C(3)A(4)）。Zta（N182Q）仅在一个半位点改变对A(3)的结合。Zta（N182S）在基序的一个或两个半位点改变对G(3)的结合。Zta（N182S）和Zta（N182Q）的中位dsDNA结合强度分别减弱34倍和17倍。Zta（N182V）和Zta（N182I）对dsDNA(5mC|C)的结合增强。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟部分解释了这些结果，识别出谷氨酰胺与A(3)之间的氢键，但未揭示丝氨酸为何优先结合G(3)，提示熵相互作用可能介导这种新的结合特异性。
